author: Afloat16
title: Preserve zero and small distances on product manifolds
body:
## Problem

`ProductManifold.dist` floors the summed squared distance at `1e-15` before taking its square root. As a result, the distance between identical points is approximately `3.16e-8`, and every smaller positive distance has a zero gradient.

For a product of Euclidean components, the displacement `(3e-10, 4e-10, 0)` should have distance `5e-10` and gradient `(0.6, 0.8, 0)`. The current floor prevents a distance-based training loss from updating that point near convergence.

## Change

Continue using `self.dist2`, but guard only exact zero values before `sqrt` and restore their zero outputs afterward. This removes the artificial floor for positive distances while selecting a finite zero subgradient at coincidence. Component metrics and the `dist2` extension point remain in use.

The regressions cover float32/float64, both `keepdim` settings, coincident points on a Sphere × Euclidean product, analytic gradients for small displacements, one real `RiemannianSGD` update, broadcasting/noncontiguous inputs, and NaN/Inf propagation.

## Validation

- [Python 3.8 / PyTorch 2.0.1 CPU](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43666798479), matching the repository's minimum CI configuration.
- [Python 3.12 / PyTorch 2.8.0 CPU](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43666592904/job/132667229629).

In each environment:
- The identical new regressions on unchanged master `4623ea1` produce **9 failures and 3 passing controls**.
- After the fix, the complete product-manifold, stereographic-product, and basic-manifold modules produce **2140 passed, 310 existing parameterized skips**. All 12 new cases pass.
- `ruff check geoopt tests/test_product_manifold.py`, `git diff --check`, and verification that tested source files remain unchanged pass.

The validation workflow is on a separate fork branch and is not included in this PR.
